outcome.technical: tools/reach-diff.py only. R48 (med): the docstring is read from the file's own source by source_docstring() - compile(..., ast.PyCF_ONLY_AST, dont_inherit=True, optimize=0) + ast.get_docstring - into DOC; REFUSALS and --help read DOC, never __doc__. Plain ast.parse was not enough: on python 3.14 under -OO it also drops the docstring (probed: None), while compile at optimize=0 keeps it on 3.14 and 3.9. _escaped's last resort is now settle(_UNREPORTED, io.StringIO()): _UNREPORTED is a Refusal made once at import by _refusal('internal', ...), pinned in _PINNED, and settle answers it with 2 and its line without reading the list or the exception. Probe: PYTHONOPTIMIZE=2 python3 tools/reach-diff.py x '' -> exit 2 under usage; python3 -OO tools/reach-diff.py --help -> exit 0 with the list. R47 (low): _refuse(result, name, why) no longer prints (out parameter dropped at every site, the walk reads the name at index 1); it records (name, why) under result['refused'] and names the first as refusal. settle is the one printer: one line per recorded refusal, or one for a refusal named with nothing recorded, so an exit-2 result always prints its line exactly once. _unsupported also refuses as internal recorded refusals that are not pairs of a listed name and a reason, or whose first is not the refusal named. Output order consequence: refusal lines now come after everything else the run printed; the 'failed' reason now says the blocks are listed above, and internal says its traceback is printed above. Test helpers _run and _judged go through settle. Docstring updated (contract, ONE PATH TO AN EXIT, _PINNED, EXIT CODES, [internal]). Cases added: rd88 (R47 bare + recorded, once each), rd89 (an exception whose __str__ raises: both attempts fail, still 2), rd90 (R48: child under PYTHONOPTIMIZE=2, usage exit 2 and --help exit 0), rd91 (two recorded refusals, each once, in order); rd77 extended with five malformed or mismatched recorded-refusal shapes. Selftest 160/160; sweep over reach-diff, test__output_lints, test__deps exit 0 (3/3 files ok). Dependants: CONTRIBUTING.md names the path and points at --help, which is unchanged and now also holds under -OO - still correct. hook_line/rebound/parse_args/settle elsewhere are other modules' own definitions sharing a name (a hyphenated file is not imported by name) - unaffected. Left as-is (same class, not in scope): ast.parse at lines 629/1056 (module under test) and refusal_sites' parse of its own source would also drop docstrings if the tool itself ran under -OO on 3.13+; reach and the walk are unaffected in practice since docstring lines are not traced and function_shape skips a leading docstring either way.
outcome.descriptive: reach-diff no longer exits 1 with a traceback under -OO, and every exit-2 result prints its refusal line exactly once, from settle.
